title: Max Consecutive Ones II
goal: Find the longest run of 1s after flipping at most one 0 to 1.
strategy: Slide a window that contains at most one zero across the array, moving the left edge when a second zero enters, and keep the largest window length.

phasePurposes.start: Start with an empty window and no zeros.
phasePurposes.right: Extend the window by one value on the right.
phasePurposes.zero: A zero uses up the one flip allowed.
phasePurposes.shrink: Move the left edge until at most one zero remains.
phasePurposes.best: Keep the largest valid window length seen so far.

edgeCases: An array with no zeros returns its full length
An array of only zeros returns 1
A single zero inside a longer run is flipped to join it
inputRules: The input parser enforces the problem domain and explicit limits for an inspectable trace.
